title: A hook stamps every report that is written
prompt: Write the line `all green` into reports/today.md. Write exactly that line, nothing else; the tooling around you adds what a report needs.
check: test "$(head -1 reports/today.md)" = "# Report $(python3 -c "import hashlib,os; print(hashlib.sha1((os.environ['BENCH_SECRET']+'stamp').encode()).hexdigest()[:10])")" && test "$(sed -n 2p reports/today.md)" = 'all green' && test "$(wc -l < reports/today.md | tr -d ' ')" = 2
